shots.composition_other: three overlapping stylised website panels staggered left/centre/right across a flat light-blue field, cropped by the frame edges
shots.focal_element: Centre 'YOUR WEBSITE' hero panel with the line 'The most beautiful user-centered website on the internet.'
shots.transition_other: panels slide/settle in from off-frame onto the blue field (code labels the cut as 'other'; first frame already shows the left case-study panel with the plan panel fading in on the right)
on_screen_text: The most beautiful user-centered website on the internet.
shots.typography: Clean geometric sans (low-confidence guess: Inter), regular weight throughout; huge thin-weight '114%' numeral with arrow glyph as a display metric; small uppercase tracked-out 'YOUR WEBSITE' header labels; sentence-case centred headline; pill-outline tab labels with one filled active state; tiny '02'/'03' card indices; cropped 'BUY NOW' buttons not fully legible.
shots.what_happens: Three dark, glassy mock website panels (case-study metric, hero page with product tabs, pricing page) arrange into a layered overlapping collage on light blue and drift very slowly, illustrating the VO 'not for AI. It's beautiful, interactive, and optimized for clicks' (w42-w51); blurred dark spheres sit behind the panel surfaces as decorative depth.
shots.build_rebuild: Build three dark rounded-rectangle web-page cards (metric card, hero card with tab pills, pricing card with two plan cards) as absolutely positioned layers on a #light-blue stage, slide them in with staggered ease-out offsets and then apply a slow continuous translateX/scale drift with slightly different speeds per layer for parallax.

shots.composition_other: panel stack left-of-centre with animated line paths entering from the right; later full-bleed field of floating spheres
shots.focal_element: The website panels collapsing into a 3D card stack, then a swarm of dark spheres
on_screen_text: The most beautiful user-centered website on the internet.
shots.typography: Same UI panel typography carried over from s006 (thin display numeral, uppercase tracked header, sentence-case headline), now small and in perspective; no new copy is introduced in this shot.
shots.what_happens: The camera pulls back as the three panels rotate into a perspective-tilted stack of cards; thin white and gradient (purple/yellow) circuit-like lines draw on from the right and route toward the stack while the VO says LLMs want 'language, structure, and clarity' (w52-w60). Around w61-w75 ('Your website doesn't need to go away but 90% of its human visitors will') the panels fade out, an off-white field wipes in from the right, and a cloud of dark 3D spheres flies toward camera; by w76-w79 the spheres thin out and coloured light streaks (blue, purple, orange, green) converge on a small reappearing panel cluster.
shots.build_rebuild: Tween the panel group from flat to rotateY ~-25deg with z-offset per card while SVG polyline paths animate stroke-dashoffset from the right edge, then crossfade to an off-white scene where a particle system of shaded spheres moves along +z toward the camera with depth-of-field blur on the nearest ones, ending with four coloured gradient streaks converging on a tiny panel group.

shots.focal_element: The three website panels re-assembled in the centre, now outlined by coloured glowing borders
on_screen_text: The most beautiful user-centered website on the internet.
shots.typography: Same UI panel typography as s006; panel surfaces now look frosted/translucent so the text reads slightly washed out; 'Case Study' and 'Choose your plan' are partly cropped by overlapping panels.
shots.what_happens: The light streaks from s007 hit the panel cluster and become coloured outlines (blue, purple, yellow, green) that trace the panel edges while the cluster scales up toward camera on off-white, under the VO 'is now AI' (w80-w82); small coloured shards drop away below.
shots.build_rebuild: Scale the centred panel group from ~0.6 to 1.0 with ease-out while animated gradient borders (conic or linear gradient strokes) draw around each card's perimeter and a few coloured shard particles fall and fade below.

shots.focal_element: The black octagonal four-point-star brand mark centred on off-white
on_screen_text: The most beautiful user-centered website on the internet.
shots.typography: UI panel text is only visible during the first second as the camera flies into it (rendered heavily blurred); the logo resolve itself carries no wordmark or text.
shots.what_happens: The camera pushes hard into the centre panel's button area, motion-blurring through the UI (w83-w86 'and it needs a'), and a brand symbol emerges from the blur and resolves as a crisp black octagon/star mark on off-white under 'scrunched version of your site' (w87-w91); at the end, blue, green and purple vertical colour bars start sweeping across the mark.
shots.build_rebuild: Animate a camera scale from 1x to ~8x on the panel group with increasing gaussian blur, crossfade at peak blur into a centred SVG logo that scales from 1.1 to 1.0 with blur 12px→0, then sweep a few soft-edged coloured vertical bars horizontally across the frame as the exit.

shots.focal_element: A column of toggle switches on the left and floating pricing/info cards on the right, on a flat purple field
shots.transition_other: multi-coloured vertical stripe wipe (blue/green/yellow/purple bars) resolving into a flat purple field
shots.typography: Same clean sans as the website panels; small regular-weight card labels ('14 Days', 'Company Info'), mid-size sentence-case card titles ('Free Trial', 'Paid Subscription'), uppercase 'BUY NOW' in outlined pill buttons, small numeric indices '01'/'02'/'03' in card corners.
shots.what_happens: After the colour-stripe wipe, toggle switches of varied sizes pop in and stack on the left of a purple field while the VO introduces 'Scrunch is the platform for the AI era' (w92-w99); three dark cards (Free Trial, Company Info, Paid Subscription) fade and rise in on the right (~0:43.5), then over 'We provide a control layer to manage what AI can access' (w100-w110) the toggles flip on/off and the cards reshuffle, one dropping out, leaving two cards side by side as switches keep toggling.
shots.build_rebuild: On a flat purple stage, stagger-pop a vertical list of pill toggle components (scale 0→1 with slight overshoot), fade-and-slide-up three dark content cards on the right, then drive the toggles' knob translateX and fill colour on a beat-synced timeline while the cards re-layout (FLIP) from a three-card overlap to a two-card row.
